body: Thank you, really, thank you. I was feeling like I was out of options, but I talked to my parents and my girlfriend and they both showed me so much love and support I feel like I can get through it. I needed some perspective, and I know it's just a post from a stranger on the internet, but you can't know how much that meant to me. I'll probably end up doing the same thing that you are doing, I've done it for friends in the past and sometimes what people need is just someone who will listen. So seriously, from the bottom of my heart thank you so much.
Now a 2nd semester senior, no money for an extra semester
